feature: PMC access by campaign start with reversible Game Controller override
policy_source: User instruction: enable by default only for the 2000 start, lock the 1970 start, and give the existing Game Controller authority to open and close the system.

default_access.authority: Human-controlled country with the existing imp_gc_nation idea. Visibility and execution both enforce authority.

closed_market.ui: PMC tab button, separate icon, main panel and both dynamic lists are hidden. All three purchase/open callbacks recheck access.
closed_market.recruitment: The 35 major-company missions and seven local recruitment decisions cannot deliver while closed. Closing removes pending orders and clears native hiring locks.
closed_market.pending_local_orders: Reverse the native prepaid 80% unit price, pending weekly expense and capacity/unit counters once per cancelled order. Previously delivered formations are retained.
closed_market.existing_contracts: Delivered units, their native weekly costs and already signed service agreements remain in force. A zero-PP player decision permits voluntary dismissal of all remaining contracted PMC units while the market is closed. Existing service-contract cancellation and expiry callbacks remain native.
closed_market.other_paths: Guard every PMC spawn provider, native pmc_can_recruit, firm-creation and management transactions, and the Constellis formation news trigger.
closed_market.initialization: Retain native registry, price and capacity initialization so that the GC can enable the system later. No country history or economy formula is rewritten.

performance.world_scans: One bounded cancellation pass when the GC closes the market, and on startup/load when it is closed. No new daily, weekly or monthly scan.
performance.ui_refresh: Reuse native international_systems_force_update after a state change.

native_preservation.procedure: python -B tools/pmc_access/patch.py verifies idempotence and exact reversal to the recorded pre-integration bytes. --rebuild removes only the recorded additions after verification and reapplies the current integration.
native_preservation.retained: Existing prices, discounts, templates, equipment, signed service agreements, normal eligibility and dismissal effects.
native_preservation.out_of_scope: The pre-existing shared-capacity reservation and weighted-capacity calculation defects are not redesigned by this access-control change.
